headline: Alaska LNG Developer Faces Scrutiny Over Sanctioned Russian Funding
summary: The developer of the Alaska LNG project is facing scrutiny over funding ties to a sanctioned Russian firm, according to the Financial Times.
why: Alaska LNG is a multi-billion dollar proposed export terminal and pipeline initiative. Financing ties involving sanctioned entities risk US regulatory blocks and severe project delays.

impacts.name: Liquefied Natural Gas
impacts.why: Sanctions scrutiny complicates financing and regulatory approvals for US energy export infrastructure.
